criteria.hypothesis: SNpp16 selectively drives the DVM motor neurons

protocol.draws: draw d = 0..n_draws-1 at k recruits k cells chosen with seed 1000 + 17 k + d, each firing one spike per wingbeat cycle at a uniform random phase with gaussian jitter (seed d; an 8 mV kick into each afferent), after 200 ms of settling
protocol.k_star_rule: the smallest k with mean DVMn 1a-c over the draws in 2-12 Hz
protocol.null: rewire_null(edges, seed=0) at k*, the same cell and phase draws
protocol.reported: SNpp07 alone (phase seeds 0-2) and k* plus SNpp07; not scored
protocol.scoring: per draw (stats.per_draw, need 0.8): PASS if 4 of the 5 draws are in band, FAIL if at most 1, else UNRESOLVED; G1 on bootstrap intervals of adjacent differences

G1_graded.rule: every adjacent step k -> k+1 of mean DVMn 1a-c is at least -0.5 Hz: the bootstrap 95% interval of the difference (independent draws) lies at or above -0.5; all steps must pass

G2_in_band_window.rule: some k puts DVMn 1a-c in 2-12 Hz, scored per draw at each k (any of the k)

G3_selective_at_k_star.condition: scored only if k* exists (some k puts mean DVMn 1a-c in band, the G2 rule); otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band)
G3_selective_at_k_star.rule: at k*: steering MN, b1 MN and DLMn c-f rates each below 1 Hz, each scored per draw, all three (the check is strict, per_draw's edge is inclusive)

G4_wiring_specific_at_k_star.condition: scored only if k* exists (some k puts mean DVMn 1a-c in band, the G2 rule); otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band); and only if the rewired null fires outside the driven cells in some draw, since a silent null cannot fail; otherwise UNRESOLVED
G4_wiring_specific_at_k_star.rule: at k*: the rewired null gives DVMn 1a-c below 1 Hz, scored per draw

G5_reliable_at_k_star.condition: scored only if k* exists (some k puts mean DVMn 1a-c in band, the G2 rule); otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band)
G5_reliable_at_k_star.rule: at k*: DVMn 1a-c in 2-12 Hz in at least 4 of the 5 draws
